data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme investing in large cap, mid cap and small cap stocks.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate long-term capital appreciation by predominantly investing in a diversified portfolio of equity & equity related instruments across large cap, mid cap and small cap stocks. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity related instruments including derivatives of Large, Mid & small cap companies - 75 to 100; Debt & Money Market Instruments - 0 to 35; Units issued by REITs & InvITs - 0 to 10
data.fund_managers: Mr. Mihir Vora and Mr. Aakash Manghani
data.exit_load: 1% - If redeemed/switched out within 180 days from the date of allotment. Nil - if redeemed/switched out after 180 days from the date of allotment.
